Recording it as NASAConclusion/author_reported_conclusion therefore reports what the authors state without turning it into a measured observation. The judge's case for 'critical' does not hold. The record does not adjudicate whether PTFE is safe, and the same Conclusions paragraph says Brass-filled PTFE 'performs similarly to TFE-Teflon' in high-pressure LOX, so the source contains no contradiction to resolve. That role covers statements about the document (title, 'this paper will compare', data-source notes, captions), and this sentence is a substantive claim about seat and seal materials. The pipeline also labels uncited author background claims as 'current' (e.g. the page 3 fire-cause sentence). This is not a cited result promoted to a current one, so there is no lineage swap. There are two minor, non-critical defects. The text keeps the stray '18' page number and the 'Conclusions' heading. 'Unknown' lineage would better signal that the claim rests on prior experience rather than this study's data. Neither creates a false scientific record.
